items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: I remember talking to Harry Carney, we were between shows, standing on the sidewalk on 44th Street.

ctx.x: And it was fun, you know, playing it.

Well, incidentally, talking about the baritone, I used to like sometimes when Harry Carney was away from Duke's band, I used to love to play the baritone, because I never saw anyone write for baritone like Duke used to write. Oh, he was beautiful. He wrote for the baritone like it was a saxophone, which it is. And these other people who wrote for baritone, they would be -- they would write for it like it was a bass. You know, you'd play the bass line. But Duke wrote for it as a -- so Benny had four saxophones,…
mixture. That's what Duke used to call it, a mixture, a mixture.
